appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Mountain Snowpack Temperature Record'.
Y-axis has labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, and 24.0.
The data is represented by a blue line with black circular markers at each data point.
Each data point has its temperature value annotated directly above it.

public_definitions: Review the mountain snowpack temperature dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period mountain snowpack temperature change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
